title: Putnami translation glossary
description: The terms of one locale, at locales/<locale>.glossary.json: each default-locale term holds its translation, or null to keep it as written, and an optional note for the translator.

translation.description: The term in the locale, or null to keep the term as written, such as a product name.

note.description: What the translator needs to know: the meaning, the register, a form to avoid.
